en: [[You]] [[must lock]] [[the doors]] and turn off the lights before you leave the house, and check the windows twice for safety.
me: and turn off the lights before you leave the house, and check the windows twice for safety
easy: turn off the lights before you leave the house
집을 나서기 전에 불을 꺼야 한다.
check the windows twice for safety
안전을 위해 창문을 두 번 확인해야 한다.
요약: 집을 나서기 전에 문 잠그기, 불 끄기, 창문 확인하기.
notes: 조동사 must 뒤는 동사원형: lock(잠그다), turn off(끄다), check(확인하다)가 and로 나란히 → 모두 동사원형
checking(-ing)은 must 뒤에 못 와요

en: By exercising regularly and maintaining a balanced diet, [[she]] [[hoped]] [[to improve her overall health]], though her progress was slowly noticed by her doctor at each visit.
me: By exercising regularly and maintaining a balanced diet,
, though her progress was slowly noticed by her doctor at each visit
easy: she hoped to improve her health
By exercising regularly and maintaining a balanced diet
규칙적으로 운동하고 균형 잡힌 식단을 유지함으로써.
though her progress was slowly noticed by her doctor
비록 그녀의 진전은 의사에게 서서히 알아차려졌지만.
요약: 운동과 식단으로 건강해지길 바랐고, 의사는 그 진전을 서서히 알아차렸다.
notes: 주어가 동작을 '받으면' 수동태(be + p.p.): her progress(진전)는 알아차림을 '당하는' 쪽 → was noticed(notice 알아차리다)
누가 했는지는 by + 사람(by her doctor, 의사에 의해)으로 알 수 있어요

en: On weekends, [[my husband and I]] either [[go]] hiking or play board games at home, since spending time together always brings us closer as a couple.
me: hiking or play board games at home, since spending time together always brings us closer as a couple
easy: my husband and I go hiking
or play board games at home
since spending time together always brings us closer as a couple
함께 시간을 보내는 것이 늘 우리를 부부로서 더 가깝게 해 주기 때문에.
요약: 주말에 함께 놀면 부부 사이가 더 가까워진다.
notes: 동명사(-ing)가 주어면 단수 취급: spending time together(함께 시간을 보내는 것) → 동사는 brings (bring 가져오다의 -s형)
예: Reading books is fun. (Reading books are ✕)
bring A closer = A를 더 가깝게 만들다

en: [[Marco]] [[travels]] to many places and takes beautiful photographs as a travel blogger, and shares his experiences with thousands of followers online.
me: to many places and takes beautiful photographs as a travel blogger, and shares his experiences with thousands of followers online
easy: takes beautiful photographs as a travel blogger
shares his experiences with thousands of followers online
온라인에서 수천 명의 팔로워와 경험을 나눈다.
요약: Marco는 여행하고 사진 찍고 그 경험을 온라인에서 나눈다.
notes: and로 이어진 동사는 모양이 같아야: travels, takes, shares (모두 주어 Marco 뒤의 현재형 -s)
sharing은 혼자서 동사가 못 돼요 → share(공유하다)의 -s형 shares

en: [[The key to success]] [[is]] [[not rushing to finish every task quickly but carefully planning each one before starting]], though some tasks are too complex to finish in a single day.
me: not rushing to finish every task quickly but carefully planning each one before starting
, though some tasks are too complex to finish in a single day
easy: The key is not rushing but planning
rushing to finish every task quickly
모든 일을 빨리 끝내려 서두르는 것.
carefully planning each one before starting
시작하기 전에 각각을 신중히 계획하는 것.
though some tasks are too complex to finish in a single day
비록 어떤 일들은 하루에 끝내기엔 너무 복잡하지만.
요약: 서두르기보다 먼저 계획하는 게 성공의 열쇠다.
notes: too + 형용사 + to + 동사원형 = 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다 (하기엔 너무 ~한). to를 빼면 안 돼요
예: too heavy to lift(lift 들다) = 들기엔 너무 무거운
The key = not rushing ~ → 주어와 보어가 같은 것 (2형식)

en: [[We]] [[have gathered]] in this meeting room to share ideas and find the best solution, focusing on what truly matters most to our team.
me: in this meeting room to share ideas and find the best solution
, focusing on what truly matters most to our team
easy: in this meeting room to share ideas and find the best solution
아이디어를 공유하고 최선의 해결책을 찾으려고 이 회의실에.
focusing on what truly matters most to our team
우리 팀에 가장 중요한 것에 집중하면서.
요약: 회의실에 모여 팀에 정말 중요한 것에 집중해 해결책을 찾는다.
notes: what = the thing which (~하는 것). 앞에 꾸밀 명사(선행사)가 없을 때 what을 써요
예: I know(know 알다) what you need. = 네가 필요한 것
that은 앞에 명사가 있어야 하고, 앞에 명사 없이 '~하는 것'이면 what

en: Take [[time]] to check your progress and set new goals for the future, and reflect honestly on what worked well.
me: to check your progress and set new goals for the future, and reflect honestly on what worked well
easy: to check your progress and set new goals for the future
진전을 확인하고 미래의 새 목표를 세울.
reflect honestly on what worked well
요약: 진전을 확인하고, 목표를 세우고, 잘된 점을 돌아볼 시간을 가져라.
notes: 명령문은 동사원형으로 시작. check(확인하다), set(세우다), reflect(돌아보다)가 and로 나란히
reflecting(-ing)이면 명령문의 동사가 아니에요

en: [[Mandy]] often [[shops]] for vegetables at the local market or walks around her neighborhood when she is free, and she will feel refreshed after she finishes her walk tomorrow.
me: for vegetables at the local market or walks around her neighborhood when she is free, and she will feel refreshed after she finishes her walk tomorrow
easy: for vegetables at the local market
or walks around her neighborhood when she is free
she will feel refreshed after she finishes her walk tomorrow
내일 산책을 마친 후에 상쾌함을 느낄 것이다.
요약: 한가할 때 장도 보고 산책도 하며, 내일 산책 후엔 상쾌할 것이다.
notes: 시간을 나타내는 after/when/before절에서는 미래의 일도 현재형으로: after she finishes(finish 끝내다) (will finish ✕)
예: I'll call(call 전화하다) you when I arrive(arrive 도착하다).

en: [[I]] [[finished]] [[washing the dishes]], but put off cleaning the bathroom until tomorrow, since my roommate suggested that we clean it together instead.
me: , but put off cleaning the bathroom until tomorrow, since my roommate suggested that we clean it together instead
easy: put off cleaning the bathroom until tomorrow
since my roommate suggested that we clean it together
룸메이트가 우리가 같이 청소하자고 제안했기 때문에.
요약: 설거지는 끝내고, 화장실 청소는 같이 하자고 해서 내일로 미뤘다.
notes: suggest(제안하다) 같은 제안·요구·주장·명령 동사 뒤 that절은 동사를 (should +) 동사원형으로: we (should) clean
예: He suggested that she go(go 가다) home. (goes ✕, went ✕)
finish 뒤에는 -ing: finished washing

en: [[The hotel]] [[would like]] [[to hire a professional and experienced manager for better service]], since many guests have complained about slow response times recently.
key: 그 호텔은 매니저를 고용하고 싶어 한다.
me: to hire a professional and experienced manager for better service
, since many guests have complained about slow response times recently
easy: The hotel would like to hire a manager
그 호텔은 매니저를 고용하고 싶어 한다.
since many guests have complained about slow response times
많은 손님들이 느린 응대에 불평했기 때문에.
요약: 손님 불만이 많아서 더 좋은 매니저를 뽑으려 한다.
notes: many + 셀 수 있는 복수명사(many guests), much + 셀 수 없는 명사(much water 물)
guests는 하나, 둘 셀 수 있으니 many

en: [[People]] [[respond]] differently to life's challenges, like taking an exam to enter a school or getting surgery, and learning to accept whatever outcome follows and move forward with confidence.
me: differently to life's challenges, like taking an exam to enter a school or getting surgery, and learning to accept whatever outcome follows and move forward with confidence
easy: to life's challenges, like taking an exam or getting surgery
시험을 치르거나 수술을 받는 것 같은 삶의 어려움에.
learning to accept whatever outcome follows
어떤 결과가 따르든 받아들이는 법을 배우고.
요약: 사람들은 어려움에 다르게 반응하지만, 결과를 받아들이고 나아가는 법을 배운다.
notes: to accept and (to) move: and 앞뒤는 같은 모양인 to부정사. 두 번째 to는 생략되어 동사원형 move
moving(-ing)은 앞의 to accept와 모양이 달라서 틀려요

en: In Greece, if a stranger appeared at your door, [[it]] [[was]] [[your duty]] to show kindness, to give him comforting shelter, and to serve him food, a tradition considered kind and respected throughout the region.
me: In Greece, if a stranger appeared at your door,
to show kindness, to give him comforting shelter, and to serve him food, a tradition considered kind and respected throughout the region
easy: if a stranger appeared at your door
to show kindness, to give him shelter, and to serve him food
친절을 보이고, 잠자리를 주고, 음식을 대접하는 것.
a tradition considered kind and respected throughout the region
그 지역 전역에서 친절하고 존중받는다고 여겨지는 전통.
요약: 낯선 사람을 따뜻하게 맞는 것이 그리스의 존중받는 전통이었다.
notes: and 앞뒤는 같은 품사: kind(친절한, 형용사) and respected(존중받는) → 둘 다 형용사 모양
respected = 존중받는 (respect 존중하다의 과거분사). 전통이 존중을 '받으니' 수동 -ed
it은 가짜 주어, 진짜 주어는 뒤의 to show ~ (할 일들)
